title: 多模态生成模糊系统：模糊推理引导的大模型交互式问答框架
summary: 提出MMGFS框架，利用模糊规则和多跳推理缓解多模态问答中的模态偏差和不确定性，增强跨域知识融合与推理深度，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
summary_en: Proposes MMGFS, a fuzzy-inference-guided multimodal generative framework that alleviates modality bias and uncertainty via fuzzy rules and multi-hop reasoning, outperforming baselines on MQA benchmarks.
